0799cc96-dfd7-4fbf-a87d-92a78e1a5f03.content: Project: FuelStationOS - Single-station desktop fuel management system with append-only ledger architecture. Tech stack: Laravel 12 (PHP 8.4+), Nuxt 3 (Vue 3), SQLite, Docker + Tauri desktop wrapper. Core features: Fuel setup (tanks, nozzles, calibrations), Operations (nozzle/deep readings), Sales & POS, Shop Inventory, Procurement (purchase orders, deliveries), Accounts (distributor/customer/employee/owner), Reporting & Dashboard. 21-table schema with polymorphic relationships and XOR constraints enforced via SQLite triggers.

6b71e45f-5596-4824-a87b-68f1d637ecff.content: Tech stack: Laravel 12 (PHP 8.4+), Nuxt 3 (Vue 3), SQLite (embedded), Docker + Docker Compose, NativePHP + Tauri desktop wrapper, Laravel Sanctum auth, spatie/laravel-permission RBAC, Laravel Queue (database driver). Scope: Single-station desktop fuel management system running offline via Dockerized backend and Tauri desktop wrapper. 21-table schema with append-only stock/payment ledgers, polymorphic relationships (stockable: Tank/Product, priceable: FuelType/Product), XOR constraints enforced via SQLite triggers.
